QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_64

question.text: If additional margin of 1% is imposed on both sides and special margin of 1% is imposed on only the buy side, a buyer's total extra margin is:

answer.text: 2% additional (both sides = buy + sell, but buyer pays only the buy side: 1% additional + 1% special = 2%)

explanation.text: The Logic: Additional margin is levied on both buy and sell sides, while special margin is levied on only one side. A buyer therefore pays 1% additional margin plus 1% special margin = 2% extra. In the workbook gold example, 1% corresponds to roughly Rs 45,000 of margin. The Trap: 1% omits the special margin. 3% incorrectly adds both sides of the additional margin to the buyer's tally. 0% ignores both levies entirely.
